extra_key: - `{key}` is not a key of the shape asked.
answer_shape: - your own answer does not fit the shape: {detail}
unknown_item: - an item id cited is not an item id in the packet.
answer_and_ruling: - `answer` must hold an answer object exactly when `ruling` is "neither", and be null otherwise.
why_items: - `why` must cite at least one item id from the packet.
